card.name: Comma closing a diuretic-therapy parenthetical
card.fires_on: The closing parenthesis and comma right after "including those on diuretic therapy" in the NSAID interaction warning for elderly, volume-depleted patients. It also fires weakly on "and" in "neonates and infants".

modes.label: Closing of volume-depleted aside
modes.description: The ")," that ends the parenthetical on diuretic therapy, just before "or have renal impairment".
modes.example: In patients who are elderly, volume-depleted (including those on diuretic therapy<<),>> or have renal impairment, co-administration

modes.label: Neonates and infants
modes.description: The word "and" joining neonates and infants in a benzyl alcohol warning.
modes.example: Serious and fatal reactions including “gasping syndrome” can occur in neonates<< and>> infants treated with benzyl alcohol-preserved
